description: `spec/` is vendored redistribution, not a dependency of this crate. Its
`package.json` and `package-lock.json` are upstream Markdoc's own, taken
verbatim at the revision `spec/UPSTREAM.md` pins, and that file's first
rule is that they are never edited. Nothing here runs JavaScript -- the
conformance harness reads `tests.yaml` from Rust and nothing else -- so a
bump there is unreachable from every test and changes no behaviour, while
costing the wholesale-replace refresh procedure the clean diff it reads as
its changelog. Renovate is told to leave the directory alone.
The two node_modules globs restate `config:recommended`'s own defaults,
which setting `ignorePaths` here would otherwise replace.
